I bought this product because of the price. And I'm SOO Impressed. The brushes are amazing and soft. Love IT!

I recently received my order. As soon as I opened I got the paint smell but that went away within a few seconds. Started looking at the brushes and saw some were repeated but that's okay, doesn't hurt to have extras ! Also saw that the big fan brush bristles or hair were falling out even on the contouring and blush. The rest were okay. You are getting what your paying for. So I guess I would recommend this to those who want low priced brush set !

The first thing I noticed is that the larger brushes had bristles just falling out. The eye shadow brushes do not collect as much product as they should. It's almost like they are too slick or something. There are several of the exact same brushes, and not a vast variety. It is a great starter kit, but I wouldn't recommend if you are looking for a professional kit.

Love each and every brush! Very minimal shedding for me (only one brush was the culprit). They feel very soft and have a decent density. The pleather case smelled a little funny, but other then that I absolutely love them!

I couldn't wait to get my brushes.  absolutely love my new brushes...My client's makeup is flawless...awesome set of brushes.
The 4 larger brushes are lower quality than the rest. I was impressed by the set! Definitely a very good buy!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brushes to be great value for the low price, often exceeding expectations for a budget set.
Several reviewers report that the larger brushes shed bristles, sometimes in big chunks.
Some reviewers note a smell upon opening, though others say theirs had no smell or it faded quickly.
A few reviewers mention receiving brushes that differ from the pictured colors or contain repeated brushes.
Some reviewers describe the brushes as stiff or rough on the face rather than soft.
